The saved comparison is complete: over 23 exactly matched elapsed sample times (0.0 h to 328.5 h), the mean signed difference in viable cell density, defined as **CHO-010-R02 minus CHO-010-R01**, was **−167,811 cells/mL** (about −0.17 million cells/mL). The largest absolute difference was **1,466,667 cells/mL** at **233.5 h**, where CHO-010-R02 was 13.40 million cells/mL versus 14.87 million for CHO-010-R01. CHO-010-R02 ran lower on average over the run; both batches peaked around 16 million cells/mL near 169–209 h.

All values come from the **Harborview CDMO fed-batch delivery, which is still in review — the values are provisional**: they were read from the delivery files and have not yet been checked by a reviewer, so verify the delivery before relying on them. The comparison is descriptive only (successive samples of one run are not independent, so no significance test applies), and batch context such as product, process version, equipment and scale was not recorded in the delivery.
